description_en: Registers an RPC service interface based on the CMNS application AppKey, interface name, and interface parameter types
description_zh: 根据cmns应用appKey、接口名称、接口参数类型等信息注册rpc 服务接口
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc create-rpc-service --project-id ftewtwyy --app-key WH2MptXX --interface-name http://www.aliyun.com/aicc/testRpc --invoke-type http --params param1,param2 --method-name testMethodName --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRpcService

parameters.help_en: The AppKey of the IoVCC CMNS application. This is the unique identifier of the application
parameters.help_zh: iovcc cmns应用appKey，应用唯一标识
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service interface.

For HTTP interfaces, specify the request URL without parameters. Example: `https://www.aliyun.com/rpcServiceTest`
parameters.help_zh:
服务接口名称。

http接口为不包含参数的请求地址。例如：`https://www.aliyun.com/rpcServiceTest`
parameters.name: interface_name

parameters.help_en:
The invocation type of the interface.

Valid values: http (including https) and hsf. HSF interfaces must be deployed in the same VPC as the IoVCC service
parameters.help_zh:
接口调用类型。

支持http（含https）和hsf。其中，hsf接口需与iovcc服务部署在同一vpc内，方能支持
parameters.name: invoke_type

parameters.help_en:
For HTTP invokes, separate parameter keys with commas (,). Example: `param1,param2`.
For HSF invokes, separate parameter types with commas (,). Only the following seven primitive data types are supported: string, int, long, bytes, double, float, and bool. Example: `string,int,long`
parameters.help_zh:
调用为http方式时，参数key以英文逗号隔开。例如：`param1,param2`。
调用为hsf方式时，参数类型以英文逗号隔开。参数基本类型仅支持string，int，long，bytes，double，float，bool7种。例如：`string,int,long`
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: The group name of the server-side interface
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The method name of the interface invocation. The name consists of letters, digits, and underscores (_).

If the invocation type is http, the name is custom-defined by the service provider.
If the invocation type is hsf, the name is the HSF interface method name
parameters.help_zh:
接口调用方法名称，由字母、数字和下划线(_)组成。

调用类型为http时，名称为服务方自定义。
调用类型为hsf时，名称为hsf接口方法名称
parameters.name: method_name

parameters.help_en: The version number of the interface. This value is custom-defined by the service provider
parameters.help_zh: 接口版本号，由服务方自定义设置
parameters.name: version_code

Id.description_en: The ID of the RPC service interface
